post.description: Upload PDF, TeX, ZIP or tar.gz; supply title and authors for PDF manuscripts. Optional metadata title and abstract_text override source metadata. PDF intake preserves original bytes and reads numbered statements from the text layer; scans without usable text are refused.  Source ZIP/tar archives may include root mathesis-evidence.json (schema_version 1, files descriptors) and matching evidence files. Digests and byte counts are computed server-side and saved on PaperVersion.evidence. Revisions must carry their own evidence; no implicit carry-forward.

get.summary: Explore shared source-declared citations from currently public accepted manuscript versions.
get.description: This is a bounded view of one shared graph, not exhaustive literature coverage or a verified proof dependency DAG. Exact supported identifiers share literature identities; metadata stays source-declared. Focus and text search are separate modes. A paper or source-local reference focus opens its accepted source directly and has no pagination. Responses are no-store.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Node identity returned by the API. paper:WP-… returns a forward neighborhood; DOI/arXiv/reference identities find citing manuscripts in the scanned page.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring of visible accepted manuscript or citation metadata in this bounded page.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Descending public record cursor. Follow even after an empty match page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Matching public accepted source records per page, clamped to 1–20 (default 10). Matching and live visibility precede pagination.

200.description: Bounded graph view and explicit coverage; an empty page can have a continuation cursor.

MethodologyReading.description: Private source-based reviewer evidence under review contract 3. Not a Lean receipt, compiled Trureturing registration or formal FIB result. Missing/unusable model evidence becomes an explicit insufficient/undetermined reading. Historical claims omit this field.

source.description: Reported opened source, or null for manuscript-local prerequisites.

information_gain.description: Optional separate analysis; never an admission gate.

confirmed_error_reports.description: Confirmed reports bound to the immutable published version and claims revision; omitted for private records. Acceptance is not mathematical verification.

solution.description: Optional target adapter, at most 1 MiB. May be empty when depositing a complete source project; verification requires a root wishpool_solution or wishpool_disproof theorem importing Target.

modules.description: Dotted module names preserve directory paths (Research.Lemmas = Research/Lemmas.lean). At most 512 modules and 8 MiB total Lean source, including the optional Solution adapter. Reserved roots and case collisions are rejected. Only the pinned prepared workspace supplies dependencies; user Lake scripts are never executed.

source_revision.description: Reported full Git revision; not independently authenticated.

project_files.description: Inert UTF-8 project configuration, at most 1 MiB total. Allowed root files: lean-toolchain, lake-manifest.json, lakefile.lean, lakefile.toml, README.md, LICENSE, LICENSE.md, LICENSE.txt. Preserved and included in project export.

source_revision.description: Reported full Git revision; not independently authenticated.

project_files.description: Inert UTF-8 project configuration, at most 1 MiB total. Allowed root files: lean-toolchain, lake-manifest.json, lakefile.lean, lakefile.toml, README.md, LICENSE, LICENSE.md, LICENSE.txt. Preserved and included in project export.

expected_target.description: SHA-256 of the target inspected by the caller. A mismatch returns 409.

solution.description: Optional complete Solution.lean adapter (up to 1 MiB) for this attempt. Deposited project modules remain unchanged; this exact adapter is bound into the attempt/receipt.

attribution.description: Reported original authors, formalization contributors, source, optional Git revision, license and deposit id; fixed on admission.

modules.description: Dotted module names preserve directory paths (Research.Lemmas = Research/Lemmas.lean). At most 512 modules and 8 MiB total Lean source, including the optional Solution adapter. Reserved roots and case collisions are rejected. Only the pinned prepared workspace supplies dependencies; user Lake scripts are never executed.

items.description: Version/claims-revision-bound report, audit and author-visible formalization outcomes. No provider identifiers, prompts, advice or private proof files.

review_contract.description: Pinned when the round is admitted; legacy defaults to 0.

review_method.description: trureturing-content-2026-10-15 for contract 3; absent on legacy rounds.

progress.description: Payload-free recorded lifecycle of each review stage; available to authors. No advice, draft text, provider identifiers or error details. A delivered letter is recorded separately in letters.

knowledge_contract.description: 3 pins identifier/path ranking and uses the saved reformulation search terms; 2 preserves full-field lexical reformulations; both require raw and Oracle queries and allow one recorded CMA follow-up batch. 1 retains raw lexical queries; absent/0 creates no retrospective evidence.

computation_contract.description: 1 enables requested finite replay before model admission. Historical absent/0 rounds retain their prompt bytes.

items.description: Immutable version-bound author response with id, author, at, round, concern and body

decision.description: Applied publication decision, including pending knowledge evidence. Null for private review-only requests.

concern.description: Zero-based index in the referenced audit concerns

LeanPreflight.description: Static diagnostics only, never a verification receipt. Errors block verification but do not block immutable source deposit.

replay_protocol.description: Optional explicit request for bounded exact replay of this certificate/computation file. Other uploads remain unexecuted.

response_id.description: Exact author response admitted into this round on this source version and claims revision

ResponseAssessment.description: Reviewer judgment, never an execution or Lean receipt. Attachment digests come from the stored source, not the model.

qualification.description: Source-audited is a reviewer judgment, not a formal certificate. Certificate claims have no admitted checker yet.

ComputationReceipt.description: Private worker-produced finite arithmetic receipt. Does not verify manuscript faithfulness, Lean proof or coverage.

expires_at.description: Future expiry within 30 days of admission.

items.description: Exact digest-bound current audited gap, CoverageSubject, complete joint binding and receipt identities.
Immutable authorization and append-only events, projected state, target and attempt receipts.

waiting_since.description: First recorded temporary service failure for this current review; omitted when service communication resumes. Contains no provider details.

source_url.description: Public HTTPS manuscript/release URL; a source association, not authenticated proof.

source_revision.description: Full Git commit. Lean links must include this revision.

paper.description: Existing NewPaper metadata, with explicit kind paper/note, purpose publication/review_only, title, ordered authors and processing_consent ai-review-2026-10-11. See MANUSCRIPT_DELIVERY.md for a complete example.

items.description: Existing ClaimConfirmation: id, kind, role, excluded, depends_on, depends_on_conjectures, settles.

processing_consent.description: The upload action requests AI processing. Use ai-review-request-2026-10-29; the legacy explicit-consent marker remains accepted for compatible clients.

metadata.description: Author-approved NewPaper metadata. Same kind/purpose as preparation; explicit title, authors, disclosure and consent required.

claims.description: Author-approved ClaimConfirmation entries for the exact prepared source.

display_text.description: Readable source citation prose without inferred author/title boundaries; raw syntax remains in reference evidence.

name.description: Exact fully qualified theorem declared in a submitted self-contained module.

total_generations.description: Lifetime total for this result and source version, including already consumed generations. A corrected target does not reset consumption. Only an explicit author request can extend it.

expires_at.description: Within 30 days; resuming does not extend this time.

change_allowance.description: Explicit authorization to change saved total or expiry, or rebind the saved allowance to a corrected confirmed target. Consumed generations are retained. Pause/resume requests without this flag must preserve the target binding and both limits exactly, including on stale concurrent requests.

managed.description: Continuous work applies to author-approved proved paper statements. Existing conjecture probes retain their finite single-attempt behavior.

modules.description: Dotted module names preserve directory paths (Research.Lemmas = Research/Lemmas.lean). At most 512 modules and 8 MiB total Lean source, including the optional Solution adapter. Reserved roots and case collisions are rejected. Only the pinned prepared workspace supplies dependencies; user Lake scripts are never executed.

deposit.description: Optional owned deposit; preserves its exact modules, source attribution, pin and original license.

modules.description: Dotted module names preserve directory paths (Research.Lemmas = Research/Lemmas.lean). At most 512 modules and 8 MiB total Lean source, including the optional Solution adapter. Reserved roots and case collisions are rejected. Only the pinned prepared workspace supplies dependencies; user Lake scripts are never executed.

joint_context.description: Complete admitted contribution context; no assertion of individual sufficiency.

required_declaration.description: Named auxiliary theorem, independently checked for exact type and submitted-module ownership. Auxiliary target imports may name only these self-contained submitted modules.

used_constants.description: Selected constants reached in the elaborated proof value. Absent on legacy receipts; never inferred from source names or imports.
